title: Agent engagement lessons inherit one causal contract before repository promotion

scope.scale: repository agent protocol / engagement / transition test

ideaContract.purpose: Preserve reusable verification lessons as evidence-bound repository knowledge without overgeneralizing one target engagement.
ideaContract.expectedOutcome: Every consequential run applies one causal spine, specialized projections, and a review-gated learning decision.
invariants: all child projections reference one canonical spine identity instead of restating mutable parent fields
each specialized projection preserves the parent causal, evidence, verification, and authority boundaries
a scoped target verdict never becomes a whole-system safety claim
a reusable lesson requires deterministic evidence and an explicit applicability boundary
evidence maturity and FCRP PASS do not grant mutation, publication, or merge authority
forbiddenOutcomes: target-specific behavior promoted as a universal repository rule
a child projection weakens the parent authority or verification contract
elapsed time or repeated prose is treated as causal learning progress
chat-local evidence is silently treated as durable repository knowledge
ideaContract.parentContract: ContractGraph-QA remains a bounded verification layer whose evidence and PASS results never create authority by themselves.

evidence.claim: The parent agent protocol bounded PASS and enumerated verification capabilities but did not require a post-run promotion decision or a shared parent contract for reusable engagement rules.
The refactor adds one canonical causal engagement spine and makes scoped verdict, temporal transition, and repository learning rules explicit spineRef-bound child projections.
The agent-learning change is isolated in a reviewable pull request rather than silently written to main.

past.summary: Reusable lessons could remain in an engagement summary or be copied into separate rules without an explicit parent causal contract.

present.summary: The review branch contains one parent spine and three bounded projections with explicit promotion and authority gates.

future.summary: Future runs conclude with evidence-bound promotion decisions while target-specific observations remain scoped or deferred.

causalPath.statement: The completion protocol stopped at reporting evidence and debt without requiring a bounded repository-learning decision under one parent causal contract.
Useful patterns could be rediscovered in later runs or promoted ad hoc without a consistent generalization and authority gate.
Extract one causal engagement spine and make scope, temporal testing, and learning explicit projections that cannot weaken it.
Agents preserve exact subject, typed time, causal path, evidence, authority, upward verification, and a review-gated learning decision at each applicable scale.

navigation.reason: Repeated work appeared inside individual engagements, but the missing guarantee belonged to the parent repository agent contract.

refactor.change: Create one causal engagement spine and bind three independently consumable projections to its invariant and authority boundaries.
refactor.expectedEffect: Future agents can retain reusable knowledge without duplicating causal policy or promoting target-specific observations as universal truth.

authorization.authorityBoundary: This self-case validates the repository learning contract only; it grants no future authority to mutate targets, publish branches, merge pull requests, or rewrite rules.
